title: WPSS/1969/2016 of Vinod Kumar AND OTHERS Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 1969/16, 1971/16, 1973/16, 1976/16, 1975/16 and
1972/16
Honíble Rajiv Sharma, J.
Mr. Vinod Joshi, Advocate holding brief of
Ms. Neetu Singh, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. N.P. Sah, Standing Counsel for the
State.
Since, the common question of law and
facts are involved in the above numbered writ
petitions, hence, are being taken up together and
are being adjudicated by this common order.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits
that the controversy, in question, in these writ
petitions is squarely covered by the judgment
rendered by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court
in WPSS No.2061 of 2015 and other analogous
matters on 21.12.2016.
Accordingly, the writ petitions are disposed
of in the terms of the judgment cited hereinabove.
Respondents are directed to consider the case of
the petitioners in compliance of directions of
Honíble Apex Court which has been referred in
the above cited judgment within eight weeks.
 (Rajiv Sharma, J.)
 11.04.2017
JKJ/Nishant
